summary: Enhance your skills in grant management and proposal writing with our comprehensive training course. Learn to secure funding effectively and efficiently.
lede: Grant proposal writing training covers how to shape project ideas into clear proposals and manage awarded grants. It is designed for grant writers, funding specialists, program managers, and finance or monitoring and evaluation professionals who prepare proposals and oversee donor-funded work. Participants practise interpreting funding requests, building a Theory of Change and logical framework, writing concept notes, developing project budgets, and preparing compliance and impact reports.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for securing institutional funding and managing the operational integrity of donor-funded projects.
modules: Grant Lifecycle and Donor Landscape Analysis
Project Design using Theory of Change
Technical Proposal Writing and Narrative Development
Grant Compliance, Risk, and Audit Readiness
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of project management and be comfortable using Microsoft Excel for simple calculations. No prior experience in grant writing is required, though familiarity with organizational strategic plans is beneficial.
topics: Financial management for NGOs & donor-funded projects
